newsitem.title: FINLAND: PENOPE SEES CLEARLY SMALLER 1996 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: PENOPE SEES CLEARLY SMALLER 1996 PROFIT.

text.p: Finnish machinery trading firm Penope Oy said on Friday that it expected its full-year 1996 result to be clearly below the level in 1995.
"The orders so far and signals from the market show that the second tertial result pace will continue until the end of the year but the result will be clearly worse than last year," it said.
In 1995, the group posted a 4.79 million markka profit before taxes and a 3.36 million markka net profit.
Penope also said in its January-August interim report that it did not expect any significant changes at the end of the year in its competitive situation or on its markets.
Its January-August profit before appropriations and taxes fell to 1.12 million markka from 3.10 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
